title: Joash Repairs the Temple

questions.question: How old was Joash when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:1 (ESV): "Joash was seven years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: What did Joash decide to do?
options: Restore the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Restore the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:4 (ESV): "After this Joash decided to restore the house of the LORD."

questions.question: Who did Joash gather to help with the restoration?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:5 (ESV): "And he gathered the priests and the Levites..."

questions.question: What was placed outside the gate of the house of the LORD to collect money?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:8 (ESV): "So the king commanded, and they made a chest and set it outside the gate..."

questions.question: What happened after Jehoiada the priest died?
options: The princes of Judah came and paid homage to the king, and the king listened to them (and they abandoned God)
questions.correctAnswer: The princes of Judah came and paid homage to the king, and the king listened to them (and they abandoned God)
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:17-18 (ESV): "...Then the king listened to them. And they abandoned the house of the LORD..."

questions.question: Who did the Spirit of God clothe to warn the people?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:20 (ESV): "Then the Spirit of God clothed Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest..."

questions.question: How was Zechariah killed?
options: They stoned him with stones in the court of the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: They stoned him with stones in the court of the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:21 (ESV): "...and stoned him with stones in the court of the house of the LORD..."

questions.question: What did Zechariah say as he died?
options: May the LORD see and avenge!
questions.correctAnswer: May the LORD see and avenge!
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:22 (ESV): "...And when he was dying, he said, 'May the LORD see and avenge!'"

questions.question: Who invaded Judah at the end of the year?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:23 (ESV): "At the end of the year the army of the Syrians came up against him..."

questions.question: Why were the Syrians able to defeat a much larger army of Judah?
options: Because they had forsaken the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Because they had forsaken the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:24 (ESV): "...Because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers, the Syrians delivered a great army into their hand."

questions.question: How did Joash die?
options: His servants conspired against him and killed him on his bed
questions.correctAnswer: His servants conspired against him and killed him on his bed
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:25 (ESV): "...his own servants conspired against him... and they killed him on his bed..."

questions.question: Why did his servants conspire against him?
options: Because of the blood of the son of Jehoiada the priest
questions.correctAnswer: Because of the blood of the son of Jehoiada the priest
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:25 (ESV): "...because of the blood of the son of Jehoiada the priest..."

questions.question: Who were the conspirators?
options: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonite, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabite
questions.correctAnswer: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonite, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabite
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:26 (ESV): "Those who conspired against him were Zabad... and Jehozabad..."

questions.question: How old was Jehoiada when he died?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:15 (ESV): "But Jehoiada grew old and full of days... he was 130 years old at his death."

questions.question: Where was Jehoiada buried?
options: In the city of David among the kings
questions.correctAnswer: In the city of David among the kings
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 24:16 (ESV): "And they buried him in the city of David among the kings..."

key_verse_text: Then the Spirit of God clothed Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, and he stood above the people and said to them, “Thus says God, ‘Why do you break the commandments of the LORD, so that you cannot prosper? Because you have forsaken the LORD, he has forsaken you.’”
